judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool paper for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, used in dataset conversion, not a description of the LEMON dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data organization, a standard used by this dataset's format, not a paper describing the LEMON dataset.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography

judgments.reason: The Scientific Data descriptor of the LEMON MPI Leipzig Mind-Brain-Body dataset (Babayan et al.) has the same authors and includes the 62-channel resting-state EEG in this dataset.
judgments.paper_title: A mind-brain-body dataset of MRI, EEG, cognition, emotion, and peripheral physiology in young and old adults
